welcome.pitch: See the jobs closest to your home and apply with one swipe.
welcome.failed: Sign-in did not complete. Try again.

consent.title: Before you start
consent.intro: Ba7dhek needs your agreement to use your data. Here is what happens to it.
consent.collect: Your name and photo from your account, what you write in your profile, a starting point you choose on the map, your applications and your messages.
consent.share: When you swipe right on a job, that employer sees your name, your photo, your profile text and a distance range. Nobody ever sees your starting point.
consent.where: On servers outside Tunisia, in the European Union and the United States.
consent.rights: You can correct your data, ask for a copy, or delete your account at any time from Settings.
consent.declinedBody: Ba7dhek cannot work without this agreement. Nothing about you has been saved beyond your sign-in.
consent.failed: Your agreement was not saved. Try again.

role.title: What brings you here?
role.candidateHint: See jobs near you and apply.
role.employerHint: Post a job and reach people nearby.
role.note: You choose once. This cannot be changed later.
role.failed: Your choice was not saved. Try again.

home.candidateBody: The job stack is not built yet. It arrives in the next milestone.
home.employerBody: Posting a job is not built yet. It arrives in the next milestone.

settings.title: Settings
settings.reloadBody: Changing to or from Arabic flips the layout, so the app restarts.

setup.title: Set up your search
setup.aboutHint: Two lines an employer will read when you apply. Do not include your health, religion or ID numbers.
setup.aboutPlaceholder: For example: three years as a waiter, free in the evenings.
setup.locationBody: Jobs are shown by distance from this point. It can be your home or a place close to it.
setup.failed: This was not saved. Check your connection and try again.

jobs.emptyBody: You have seen every job in your area. New ones will show up here as they are posted.
jobs.noHomeBody: Choose a starting point to see the jobs near it. It can be your home or any place nearby.
jobs.swipeFailed: Your choice was not saved. Check your connection.

errors.blockedText: This text contains something that is not allowed, such as asking candidates for money or for a criminal record.
errors.notApproved: Your business is still being checked, so the job cannot go live yet.

employer.title: Your jobs
employer.noCompanyBody: Add your business once. We check it before your first job goes live.
employer.pending: Your business is being checked. You can prepare a job now; it goes live once you are approved.
employer.noJobsBody: Post your first job and people nearby will see it.

preview.title: Preview
preview.note: Sample data. This page exists only in development builds.

location.denied: Location access was refused. You can allow it in your phone settings.
location.failed: Your location could not be read. Try again outside or near a window.
location.outsideTunisia: That point is outside Tunisia. Ba7dhek only covers Tunisia.
location.privacy: Read once, when you tap. Nobody else ever sees this point.

company.title: Your business
company.name: Business name
company.addressHint: Street and area, as people nearby would say it.
company.locationBody: Stand at the business and tap the button. Jobs you post are shown to people near this point.
company.rule1: You are the business that will employ the person.
company.rule2: The job is in Tunisia, at the place you pin.
company.rule3: The pay you state is real.
company.rule4: Candidates are never asked to pay anything.
company.needLocation: Set where the business is first.
company.failed: Your business was not saved. Check the fields and try again.
company.taxIdHint: As printed on your tax card. We use it to check the business before your first job goes live. Candidates never see it.
company.taxIdInvalid: This does not look like a matricule fiscal. It is seven digits and a letter, for example 1234567A/A/M/000.
company.taxIdTaken: A business with this tax ID is already registered.
company.individualNote: For someone hiring for their own home or their own work, with no registered business. We may contact you before your first job goes live.

job.title: Post a job
job.descriptionHint: Hours, tasks, what you expect. Write in the language your candidates read.
job.locationNote: The job uses your business location.
job.needPay: Enter the pay as a number above zero.
job.failed: The job was not saved. Check the fields and try again.

applicants.title: Applicants
applicants.emptyBody: People nearby see this job in their stack. Applicants appear here in the order they apply.
applicants.failed: Your decision was not saved. Try again.

applications.title: Your applications
applications.emptyBody: Swipe right on a job to apply. Your applications and their answers show up here.

intro.nearBody: Ba7dhek shows the jobs closest to where you start from, nearest first. No more scrolling past jobs across the country.
intro.nearExample: A hotel near you is hiring
intro.swipeBody: Try it on this card. Right applies, left passes.
intro.swipeApplied: That is all it takes. The employer sees your profile and answers in the app.
intro.swipePassed: That was a pass. Now try swiping right.

devSetup.title: Setup is not finished
devSetup.body: This build is missing configuration, so it cannot sign anyone in yet.

toast.businessAdded: Business added. We will check it shortly.

crash.title: Something broke
crash.body: The app hit a problem it did not expect. What you already saved is safe.

images.title: Photos of this job
images.body: Up to 4 photos of the job or the workplace. The first one sits at the top of the card people swipe.
images.invalid: That file is not a photo the app can use. Try a JPEG or PNG.
images.tooLarge: That photo is too large even after shrinking. Try another.
images.tooMany: You already have 4 photos. Remove one to add another.
images.failed: The photo was not saved. Check your connection and try again.
images.shrinkNote: Photos are shrunk on your phone before they are sent.

photo.title: Your photo
photo.shownNote: Employers you apply to see this photo.
photo.noneNote: You are showing no photo. You can still apply to any job.
photo.removed: Your photo is no longer shown

logo.title: Logo
logo.body: One image. It appears beside your business name on every job you post.

detail.ownerNote: This is how people nearby see your job.
detail.goneTitle: This job is no longer available
